EXPERIENCE

Staff Nurse (Telemetry Lead), Medical Ward 5B, Hospital Seri Kenanga - Mar 2022 to present
- Lead telemetry nurse for a 30-bed acute medical ward, monitoring up to 8 cardiac patients per shift; escalated 40+ arrhythmias to the on-call team in 2025 with zero missed alarms on audit.
- Cut patient falls on the ward from 9 to 3 a year by introducing an hourly rounding checklist, since adopted by all three medical wards.
- Performed 600+ IV cannulations at a 94% first-attempt success rate, logged for the hospital's vascular access audit.
- Preceptored 8 newly registered nurses through the six-month competency programme; all eight passed their first assessment.
- Raised medication documentation compliance in the EMR from 81% to 98% across two quarterly audits by coaching staff during handover.

- Delivered direct care to 6-8 patients per shift on a 32-bed inpatient ward on a rotating three-shift roster.
- Administered IV medications and blood transfusions under the double-check protocol with no reportable errors in two years.
- Member of the ward rapid response team; attended 70+ code blue calls.
